title: Needle
description: A turntable seen from above with a real record under your hand. Scratch it forwards and backwards, let go and the platter pulls it back up to 33⅓, or lift the tonearm and drop it anywhere on the grooves to cue.
intent: One music object finished to the edge: the record is the transport, so the hand on the vinyl is the playhead, and the grooves you can see are the beat you hear.
